public.title: Palindrome Number
public.description: Return whether the ordinary base-ten representation of integer n reads the same in both directions. Negative numbers are not palindromes. n is between -2147483648 and 2147483647. Zero is a palindrome; trailing zeros are significant.
hints: Compare corresponding decimal digits from opposite ends.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Reject negatives and compare digit pairs. O(log n) time and digit-string space.
